info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete P2m By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to remove specific webhook endpoints based on a given parameter. By specifying 'param1', consumers can effectively manage the lifecycle of their webhook integrations within the system. Typical use cases include cleaning up unused endpoints or adjusting configurations in response to changes in business logic. This API is particularly useful for developers and system administrators looking to maintain streamlined and efficient webhook management.

delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a webhook endpoint identified by its unique identifier. Make sure to handle any dependencies or side effects that might arise from the deletion of this resource.
